grammar.silhouette: Large sideways machine over a broad hooked contact-floor skid.
grammar.motion: Enter turn, cut a growing outside hook, throw grit and release the arc.
grammar.location: Floor/contact point outside the turn, below the rotor.
grammar.persistence: Only actual brake-turn drift/arc state; scuffs settle after the carving beat.
grammar.palette: Worn steel floor scars, muted teal edge and brass grit.
grammar.feature: One short concave floor cut with displaced outer grit; no rotor aura or long Flow rails.

notes: Rank II adds a second outside skid groove and extra displaced grit, staying at the contact plane.
source_direction_contract: Upright artwork; heading suffix chooses pre-authored screen-direction placement e/ne/n/nw/w/sw/s/se. No runtime rotation of isometric art.
authoring: Distinct pixel-cluster compositions and deliberate key poses assembled as normal editable native Aseprite layers. Scripted authorship, not manual mouse painting. Saved masters are the editing authority.

review_tier.after: B/A candidate pending full roster, grayscale and motion review

card_story: Twelve unequal-duration keys: anticipation, action, mechanical reaction, follow-through and intentional reset. Not six arbitrary cycling decorations.
